reviewMethod: Author reviewed every field directly against canonical Japanese while translating, then checked full pair for source fidelity and semantic distinctions. No peer output read.

semanticChecks.fullTextCoverage: All source fields fully translated; no summaries.
semanticChecks.negationsAndUncertainty: Preserved unreceived, unconfirmed, unmeasured, not necessarily, and no inference of suitability or approval.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndScope: Reviewed distinctions between access/work floor, equipment receipt/installation, component presence/locked state, top cap/standing platform, handhold/guardrail, mobility/working stability, floor height/reach height, training/machine classification, sweeping/collection, and blowing/dust collection.
semanticChecks.technicalTerms: Thai and Khmer technical vocabulary reviewed directly against Japanese. Product nicknames transliterated with local-script descriptors for standalone key terms.
semanticChecks.numbers: Every translation matches exact source ASCII-number token multiset; spelled-out Japanese counts translated as words.
semanticChecks.sourceIntegrity: Every sourceJa copied exactly from canonical Japanese.
semanticChecks.noAddedInstructions: No operational procedures, numeric thresholds, or safety instructions added beyond those explicitly present in the Japanese source.
semanticChecks.script: All Khmer fields contain Khmer script and all Thai fields contain Thai script; no Japanese script leakage or local numeral digits.

limitations: Author self-review only; no independent peer or native-speaker validation.
